say.en: Hydrogen bonds and a hidden acid. Ethanol boils at 351 kelvin while propane, of nearly the same mass, boils at 231 kelvin. And phenol, once called carbolic acid, burns the skin. The -OH group explains both. In this lesson: Explain boiling points and solubility through hydrogen bonding.
Compare the acidity of alcohols, water and phenols.
Predict the effect of substituents on the acidity of phenols.

body.en: Alcohols and phenols form intermolecular hydrogen bonds, so they boil much higher than hydrocarbons, ethers and haloalkanes of similar mass. *Boiling point* rises with the number of carbons and falls with branching. Lower alcohols mix with water because they hydrogen-bond with it; solubility falls as the hydrophobic alkyl part grows.
body.kn: OH ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಬಂಧದಿಂದ ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್‌ಗಳ ಕುದಿಬಿಂದು ಹೆಚ್ಚು. ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್‌ಗಳು ನೀರಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಬಂಧ ಮಾಡಿ ಕರಗುತ್ತವೆ; ಆಲ್ಕೈಲ್ ಗುಂಪು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾದಂತೆ ವಿಲೇಯತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

narration.en: Hydrogen bonding between OH groups makes alcohols boil much higher than alkanes or ethers of similar mass. Small alcohols dissolve in water because they hydrogen bond with it, but bigger alkyl groups reduce solubility.

say.en: Alcohols form hydrogen bonds between molecules. Breaking them needs extra energy, so boiling points are high.
Compare three compounds of nearly the same mass. Ethanol boils far higher than propane or dimethyl ether.
Alcohols are very weak acids: they react with sodium but not with sodium hydroxide. Phenol is acidic enough to react with sodium hydroxide.

problem.en: Phenol has pKa = 10.0 and ethanol has pKa = 15.9. How many times stronger an acid is phenol?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Phenol has pKa = 10.0 and ethanol has pKa = 15.9. How many times stronger an acid is phenol?

say.en: Let us solve this together. Phenol has pKa equals 10.0 and ethanol has pKa equals 15.9. How many times stronger an acid is phenol?
Kaphenol equals 10 to the power minus 10 to the power 0; Kaethanol equals 10 to the power minus 15 to the power 9.
Ratio equals 10 to the power minus 10 to the power 0 divided by 10 to the power minus 15 to the power 9 equals 10 to the power 5 to the power 9.
10 to the power 5 to the power 9 is approximately 7.9 times 10 to the power 5.
So the answer is About 7.9 times 10 to the power 5 times nearly a million.

say.en: Let us solve this together. What volume of hydrogen at STP is released when 4.6 grams of sodium reacts completely with excess ethanol? (Na equals 23; molar volume 22.4 L).
2 C 2H 5OH plus 2 Na gives 2 C 2H 5ONa plus H 2.
4.6 grams Na equals 4.6 over 23 equals 0.2 moles, giving 0.1 moles H 2.
Volume equals 0.1 times 22.4 equals 2.24 L.
So the answer is 2.24 L of H 2 at STP.

points.en: –NO₂ raises and –CH₃ lowers the acidity of phenol.

homework.en: Explain why o-nitrophenol and p-nitrophenol are more acidic than m-nitrophenol.

narration.en: Recap. Hydrogen bonding raises the boiling points and water solubility of alcohols and phenols. Alcohols react with Na but not NaOH; acidity 1° > 2° > 3°. Phenol is more acidic because phenoxide is resonance-stabilised. –NO₂ raises and –CH₃ lowers the acidity of phenol.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಬಂಧ ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಫೀನಾಲ್‌ಗಳ ಕುದಿಬಿಂದು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಲೇಯತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್ Na ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಿಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, NaOH ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಲ್ಲ; ಆಮ್ಲೀಯತೆ 1° > 2° > 3°. ಫೀನಾಕ್ಸೈಡ್ ಅನುರಣನದಿಂದ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಫೀನಾಲ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಮ್ಲೀಯ. –NO₂ ಫೀನಾಲ್ ಆಮ್ಲೀಯತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, –CH₃ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Chemical reactions of alcohols and phenols

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Hydrogen bonding raises the boiling points and water solubility of alcohols and phenols.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಬಂಧ ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಫೀನಾಲ್‌ಗಳ ಕುದಿಬಿಂದು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಲೇಯತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Alcohols react with Na but not NaOH; acidity 1 degrees is greater than 2 degrees is greater than 3 degrees.
say.kn: ಆಲ್ಕೋಹಾಲ್ Na ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಿಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, NaOH ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಲ್ಲ; ಆಮ್ಲೀಯತೆ 1 degrees is greater than 2 degrees is greater than 3 degrees.

say.en: Phenol is more acidic because phenoxide is resonance-stabilised.
say.kn: ಫೀನಾಕ್ಸೈಡ್ ಅನುರಣನದಿಂದ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಫೀನಾಲ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಮ್ಲೀಯ.
